title: Silas and the Contact
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
